input_contract: Input is an object with key 'graph' which is a dictionary mapping course name (string) to list of immediate successor courses (prerequisites are from course to dependent). Return a list of courses in a valid order such that all prerequisites come before each course.

variants.name: Kahn's Algorithm (BFS)
variants.strategy: Maintain indegree table and a queue of zero-indegree nodes; repeatedly pop a node, append to order, and decrement indegrees of neighbors, enqueue when indegree reaches 0.

pseudocode: For each neighbor, decrement indegree; if 0, enqueue

variants.name: DFS Post-order
variants.strategy: Perform DFS from each unvisited node; mark as visited, recurse on neighbors, then append node to order (post-order). Finally reverse the order to get topological sort.

pseudocode: For each unvisited node, perform DFS
Reverse order to get topological sort
